requirement: Verify whether Identity Platform blocking functions, user actions, or tenant configuration can reject the MoolSocial Google sign-in exchange.
affectedLayer: Firebase Authentication with Identity Platform server-side rejection controls
evidence: The project uses Firebase Authentication with Identity Platform.
The live Google credential exchange rejects after identity return.
Read-only Firebase Console verification proves both blocking-function hooks are unconfigured.
Read-only Firebase Console verification proves user creation is enabled; deletion and email-enumeration controls do not reject this Google creation/sign-in path.
Read-only Google Cloud Identity Platform verification proves multi-tenancy is disabled and no tenant routing applies.
correctiveAction: Read back blocking-function, user-action, and tenant state; fix only a proven rule, hook, or tenant mismatch affecting this Google flow.
testPlan: Classify each rejection control as enabled/aligned, disabled, or not applicable.
If enabled, verify its safe logs/status for the single failed Google attempt without account identity or payloads.
If unused, record evidence and close without changes.
acceptanceCriteria: All three server-side rejection-control states are proven.
Any proven mismatch is corrected and directly verified, or the ticket is closed PASS/NOT_APPLICABLE with evidence.
regressionRisk: Changing a blocking function or tenant setting without evidence can alter authentication for every user.
exclusions: No function deployment, tenant migration, or production change without a proven gap and explicit authorization.
